newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cert coffee stocks fall 1,607 bags Jan 3 week.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cert coffee stocks fall 1,607 bags Jan 3 week.

text.p: U.S. certified coffee stocks fell by more than four percent in the week ended January 3, declining 1,607 60-kg bags to 32,458 bags, the Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange reported on Monday.
No stocks were pending grading or recertification, the CSCE added.

The bulk of the decrease this week came in New Orleans, where stocks fell by 857 bags to 6,911 bags. Stocks in Miami warehouses declined by 750 bags to 24,769 bags, while inventories in New York and San Francisco were unchanged at 778 bags and 0 bags respectively.
